# Fort Worth Wellness Center

> Residential mental health, dual diagnosis and medical detox treatment center in Weatherford, Texas, serving Fort Worth and the DFW area with 24/7 clinical support.

Address: 101 Mariah Drive, Weatherford, Texas 76087. Admissions (24/7): 817-612-6807. Email: info@fortworthwellness.org.

## Overview

- [Fort Worth Wellness Center | Mental Health & Detox Care](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/): Fort Worth Wellness Center provides residential mental health, dual diagnosis, and medical detox care with 24/7 clinical support in a private, restorative Texas setting.
- [Blog — Mental Health Insights](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/blog/): Expert articles on mental health, addiction recovery, detox, and dual diagnosis from the clinical team at Fort Worth Wellness Center.

## Treatment

- [Mental Health & Detox Programs](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/treatment/): Explore residential mental health, dual diagnosis, detox, and aftercare programs at Fort Worth Wellness Center — therapy and 24/7 clinical support in a private setting.
- [Who We Help — Specialized Tracks](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/who-we-help/): Specialized residential mental health tracks in Fort Worth for professionals, veterans, first responders, women, men, young adults, and college students.
- [Aftercare & Alumni Support](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/treatment/aftercare/): Stay connected after treatment with Fort Worth Wellness Center aftercare and alumni support — a structured step-down plan and lifelong community for continued growth.
- [Medical Detox & Stabilization](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/treatment/detox/): Safe, medically supervised drug & alcohol detox with 24/7 clinical support and a smooth transition into residential mental health treatment.
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/treatment/dual-diagnosis/): Integrated dual diagnosis care in Fort Worth — treating mental health and co-occurring substance use together, addressing the root cause for lasting stability.
- [Residential Inpatient Care](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/treatment/mental-health-residential/): Residential inpatient care in Fort Worth with 24/7 psychiatric support, evidence-based therapy, and a restorative home-like setting for lasting stability.

## Admissions & Insurance

- [Admissions — Start Treatment Today](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/admissions/): Our Fort Worth admissions team makes starting mental health care simple — same-day placement, clear insurance guidance, and 24/7 confidential support.
- [Contact Our Admissions Team](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/contact/): Call or message the Fort Worth Wellness Center team for admissions guidance, insurance help, and 24/7 support starting mental health care.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.fortworthwellness.org/faq/): Answers about admissions, insurance, medical detox, residential mental health care, and dual diagnosis treatment at Fort Worth Wellness Center.
